parameters.query:
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM citybikes_station_events) = 0
    THEN json_build_object('error', 'Aucune donnée disponible. Le script d''ingestion n''a pas encore inséré de données.')
    ELSE json_build_object(
      'generated_at', NOW(),
      'data_range', (
        SELECT json_build_object(
          'oldest', MIN(event_timestamp),
          'newest', MAX(event_timestamp),
          'total_events', COUNT(*),
          'total_stations', COUNT(DISTINCT station_id)
        )
        FROM citybikes_station_events
      ),
      'top_usage', (
        SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(r), '[]'::json) FROM (
          SELECT
            station_id,
            station_name,
            network,
            latitude,
            longitude,
            ROUND(AVG(bikes_available::numeric / NULLIF(bikes_available + free_slots, 0)) * 100, 1) AS usage_rate_pct,
            ROUND(AVG(bikes_available)::numeric, 1) AS avg_bikes,
            ROUND(AVG(free_slots)::numeric, 1) AS avg_free_slots,
            COUNT(*) AS samples
          FROM citybikes_station_events
          WHERE event_timestamp >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
          GROUP BY station_id, station_name, network, latitude, longitude
          HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
          ORDER BY usage_rate_pct DESC NULLS LAST
          LIMIT 10
        ) r
      ),
      'insufficient_zones', (
        SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(r), '[]'::json) FROM (
          SELECT
            station_id,
            station_name,
            network,
            latitude,
            longitude,
            COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE bikes_available = 0) AS zero_bike_count,
            ROUND(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE bikes_available = 0)::numeric / COUNT(*) * 100, 1) AS zero_bike_pct,
            ROUND(AVG(bikes_available)::numeric, 1) AS avg_bikes,
            COUNT(*) AS samples
          FROM citybikes_station_events
          WHERE event_timestamp >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
          GROUP BY station_id, station_name, network, latitude, longitude
          HAVING COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE bikes_available = 0) > 0
          ORDER BY zero_bike_pct DESC
          LIMIT 20
        ) r
      ),
      'daily_peaks', (
        SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(r), '[]'::json) FROM (
          SELECT
            TO_CHAR(date_trunc('hour', event_timestamp), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:00') AS hour_label,
            SUM(bikes_available) AS total_bikes,
            SUM(free_slots) AS total_free_slots,
            ROUND(AVG(bikes_available::numeric / NULLIF(bikes_available + free_slots, 0)) * 100, 1) AS avg_usage_pct,
            COUNT(DISTINCT station_id) AS active_stations
          FROM citybikes_station_events
          WHERE event_timestamp >= NOW() - INTERVAL '48 hours'
          GROUP BY date_trunc('hour', event_timestamp)
          ORDER BY date_trunc('hour', event_timestamp) DESC
          LIMIT 48
        ) r
      ),
      'geographic_imbalances', (
        SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(r), '[]'::json) FROM (
          SELECT
            station_id,
            station_name,
            network,
            latitude,
            longitude,
            ROUND(AVG(bikes_available)::numeric, 1) AS avg_bikes,
            ROUND(AVG(free_slots)::numeric, 1) AS avg_free_slots,
            ROUND(ABS(AVG(bikes_available - free_slots))::numeric, 1) AS imbalance_score
          FROM citybikes_station_events
          WHERE event_timestamp >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
          GROUP BY station_id, station_name, network, latitude, longitude
          HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
          ORDER BY imbalance_score DESC
          LIMIT 20
        ) r
      ),
      'critical_stations', (
        SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(r), '[]'::json) FROM (
          SELECT
            station_id,
            station_name,
            network,
            latitude,
            longitude,
            COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE bikes_available = 0) AS no_bike_count,
            COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE free_slots = 0) AS no_slot_count,
            COUNT(*) AS total_observations,
            ROUND(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE bikes_available = 0)::numeric / COUNT(*) * 100, 1) AS no_bike_pct,
            MAX(event_timestamp) AS last_seen
          FROM citybikes_station_events
          WHERE event_timestamp >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
          GROUP BY station_id, station_name, network, latitude, longitude
          HAVING
            COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE bikes_available = 0) > 0
            OR COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE free_slots = 0) > 0
          ORDER BY GREATEST(no_bike_count, no_slot_count) DESC
          LIMIT 20
        ) r
      ),
      'live_snapshot', (
        SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(r), '[]'::json) FROM (
          SELECT
            station_id,
            station_name,
            network,
            latitude,
            longitude,
            bikes_available,
            free_slots,
            event_timestamp AS last_update
          FROM citybikes_station_last_status
          ORDER BY updated_at DESC
          LIMIT 50
        ) r
      )
    )
  END AS report;
